blocks.value: As businesses grow, they need better organization. A company is simply a business that is legally registered and recognized by the government.

Imagine This: Your tea shop becomes so popular that you open 20 branches across different cities. You hire employees, maintain accounts, pay taxes, and register your business. It is no longer just a small shop—it has become a company.
Companies can own property, hire employees, borrow money, pay taxes, sign contracts, and continue operating even if their owners change.
Apple, Reliance, Infosys, Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), and HDFC Bank are all companies.
Every large company started as a small business.

blocks.question: Which of these is a company?
